definitions: The number 1010100 or 10googol, ten to the power of a googol. .mw-parser-output .defdate{font-size:smaller}

blocks.text: A googolplex is the large number 1010100, that is, 10 raised to the power of a googol. If written out in ordinary decimal notation, it would be 1 followed by a googol (10100) zeroes‍—‍‌a physically impossible number to write explicitly.
